comment: The four screenshots in screenshots/, and how the app is set up for each. Open app/index.html with ?shot=<id> (served by serve.ts) and the app renders that shot full-window; app/src/shots.js holds the same list for the app itself.

shots.shows: The exported portrait cover, 1080 x 1350 shown scaled down: Diagonal Six layout, Vice Sunset grade, the two bundled samples cropped six ways, striped sun, palms and the LEONIDA NIGHTS caption.
The editor in a browser at 1280 x 800 with the samples loaded: photo, layout, grade, caption and export controls beside the live preview, the first panel selected.
The exported square cover, 1080 x 1080 shown scaled down: Diagonal Strips layout with the Neon Nights grade, so it differs from the portrait cover in both shape and look.
The exported wide cover, 1920 x 1080 shown scaled down: Hero + Three layout with the Golden Hour grade.
